steps.note: The whole soured milk is churned, as in Morocco where it yields butter and lben.

processing.text: In a dairy the cream is soured first: heated to at least 85 °C for 15 s, ripened 12–15 hours with a starter, then churned.

sources.text: Churning soured milk into butter, from the Moroccan paper; the dairy way with cream from the handbook.
